source_text: Sacerdos qui offert illud comedet. Qui verbum ministrat, vivat de evangelio. Non mercenarius sed pastor.
pass_a_gloss: Priest who offers it will-eat. Who word ministers, let-him-live from gospel. Not hireling but shepherd.
pass_b_english: [[The priest who offers it shall eat it >> Bible:Leviticus 6:26]]. Who ministers the word may live from the gospel — not as hireling but as shepherd.
